# ChoreScore product reconstruction — operating mission

The owner wants the application completed, not an audit, a CI dashboard or an
APK factory. Work directly in feat/product-reconstruction, integrated PR #2.
All work must remain free. The latest explicit owner instruction authorizes
one OpenCode worker to audit, implement and iterate using the earlier projects.

OpenCode's remote free endpoint actually refused every tested model with
"Free usage limit reached" on 2 November. Do not pay, change identities, rotate
IPs or bypass that limit. The worker now runs Apache-2.0 Qwen3 weights on the
standard public GitHub runner CPU through localhost llama.cpp. No inference
API key, provider account, GPU or billing service is involved. Model and runtime
revisions/checksums are recorded. The capability probe must edit a broken
source fixture and pass the unchanged test; inference alone is insufficient.
The trusted controller executes that test after a completed edit and stops
the capability probe on verified success; it does not wait for a stalled
model to announce completion. This shortcut applies only to the tiny probe.
Actual product patches still require every independent acceptance gate.
Run 41936741692 proved real notification delivery, both todo completions,
correct initial balances and a photo reopened after process death. Its next
failure was after expense deletion: the preserved screen still showed the
native confirmation. The driver tapped the title "Supprimer" instead of the
uppercase positive button "SUPPRIMER". It now targets android:id/button1 and
checks the app package and expected action. The existing exact balance
assertions remain unchanged. Use the next installed baseline, repair its
actual next failure, and never change accounting to compensate for a dialog.
The owner reports production Firestore rules published; no administrator
session or real Google/two-phone acceptance is available in this environment.
The latest three official Firestore scenarios pass, including cached photo
deletion and incomplete/replayed deltas. Do not spend a pass fixing an older
green transport check. Passing checks are summarized; focus on the current FAIL.

Read AGENTS.md, CODEX_MISSION.md, PRODUCT.md and the cumulative requirements
matrix in docs/CROSS_REPOSITORY_REQUIREMENTS.md. The originals are pinned by

Do not reread the complete historical VERIFICATION.md or all 34 snapshots on

Use V1's visual quality and retained V2/V3 privacy requirements. Do not bring

server revision with unchanged records and no duplicate server writes. Its
Node HTTP transport uses fresh sockets after authority restart; the former

This test correction is not a completed Firebase or native product journey.

The trusted baseline now runs the browser AND installed Android journey before
choosing a repair, stopping on the first concrete failure. Read that current
failure before older logs. The Android journey uses real device APIs, records
video and verifies photos, actual notification delivery, both todo kinds,
sharing, exact splits, process-death persistence and explicit compensation at
a French decimal rate. Its independent evidence gate rejects missing captures
and APK digest mismatches. Fix product behavior; do not bypass these controls.

At each pass:
1. Audit the actual current source and the first concrete failing check.
2. Repair that failure. If checks pass, implement the next incomplete vertical
   product slice from the requirements matrix, including persistence/errors/UI.
3. Add a meaningful regression test. Existing tests and specifications are
   protected by the harness; do not edit or bypass them.
4. Verify exact accounting, group isolation, identity permanence, atomic todos,
   private media and offline recovery. Never replace real services by mocks.
5. Record what changed and what was really executed in VERIFICATION.md.

Priority: official Firestore authority and direct-client attacks, complete
native photo/reminder/share/todo journeys, real collaboration, then remaining
UX/accessibility and persistent consent-based research. Do not claim in-memory
transport tests prove Firestore rules or an iOS JS export proves an iPhone run.
No Firebase production access is provided to this worker. Do not enable billing,
create production users, send messages, or invent credentials. If an external
step cannot be performed, continue independent product work and state the gap.

Do not modify .github/, scripts/ci/, opencode.json, the mission documents,
historical snapshots or existing tests. Do not change Git history, commit,
push, merge, dispatch workflows or use a paid model. The trusted runner handles
verification and publication. A prose-only update is rejected. Do not weaken
security, suppress app crashes/ANRs or skip the real native assertions.

No claim of "perfect" or "complete" is accepted without the actual native,
cross-account Firebase, privacy, accounting and UI acceptance evidence. Green
automated checks establish their covered scenarios only.

Verified source is integrated by the trusted publisher, which explicitly
resumes the same programme on that new revision. Existing public GitHub token
push suppression must never silently stop product reconstruction. If an
external service cannot run or no verified patch is produced, the failed
checks and candidates remain evidence; do not publish a false completion.

## Continuity of the same mission

A failed implementation cycle with retained iteration evidence schedules the next
cycle after the free-model capability probe passes. Setup/probe failures remain
explicit failures rather than unattended bootstrap retries. Unpublished patches
may resume only on their exact upstream revision and only inside the existing
source allowlist. They are never considered verified by restoration. All six
independent gates still apply before integration into PR #2. A pass without a
source edit keeps the last actual check failure as its next work order.

Once a product slice passes every gate, publish that verified slice immediately;
the next workflow audits the remaining requirements. Android verification is
queued by branch and completes its installed journey before the latest pending
version starts. Never mark the entire product complete from a compilation, an
agent message or a checkpoint; genuine Google/two-device acceptance remains
separate. No automatic merge or production deployment is authorized here.

## Stop before unnecessary rewrites

When the current baseline passes all six independent gates, do not start the
writer. Freeze the candidate with status awaiting-final-acceptance. A restored
checkpoint that passes that baseline may be integrated without another edit;
its successor runs one final verification and then stops. With no verified
patch, the publication and continuation jobs are skipped. Green automation is
not full product acceptance: original-specification review, real Google login
and production collaboration remain explicit proofs. Do not invent features or
rewrite working screens simply to produce another commit.
